model.name: MLP-Mixer B/16
model.mixer: token-mixing MLP 196 → 384 → 196 with exact GELU, shared by all 768 channels

examples.title: Cat
examples.prompt: Closeup photo of a cat · 224 × 224 · top-1 Egyptian cat (99%)

examples.title: Beagle
examples.prompt: Photo of a beagle · 224 × 224 · top-1 beagle (93%)

examples.title: Astronaut
examples.prompt: Bruce McCandless II during EVA, 1984 · 224 × 224 · top-1 space shuttle (100%)

examples.title: Colored shapes
examples.prompt: Red circle, blue square and green triangle · 224 × 224 · top-1 envelope (97%)

capture.dtype: float32 (the matrices are built and checked in float64)
capture.preprocessing: the 224 × 224 image as drawn, normalized with the model’s mean and std (0.5); its crop_pct resize is off
capture.tokens: 16 × 16 patches on the 14 × 14 grid in row-major order, labelled "row,column"
capture.x: input to the token-mixing MLP: the block input after norm1 (LayerNorm over channels)
capture.out: output of mlp_tokens, before the residual add and the channel-mixing MLP

shapes.alt: Red circle, blue square and green triangle

capture.matrixChangeNote: ‖M − M_cat‖ / ‖M_cat‖ over the stored channels, per block

extras.weights: effective mixing M_c = W2 · diag(Φ(h_c)) · W1 of the first 3 channels: input-dependent, through the GELU gates
extras.v: input tokens of the first 3 channels, (channels, 196, 1)
extras.heads: recorded token-MLP output of the first 3 channels, (channels, 196, 1): weights @ v + bias
extras.bias: β_c = W2 · diag(Φ(h_c)) · b1 + b2 of the first 3 channels: input-dependent too
extras.gate: Φ(h_c) for the first 3 channels, one per hidden unit: GELU(h) = h · Φ(h)
extras.w1: fc1 weights of 16 hidden units (the largest by norm), one weight per token: fixed after training
extras.w1Units: indices of those hidden units, of 384
